quality.next_cycle_experiment: Instrument one privacy-safe entry-to-first-lesson funnel by discovery path and compare first-lesson start plus seven-day repeat-learning rates for four weeks.

findings.summary: The entry page records content-recovery events and several bounded learning-task outcomes, but it lacks one measurable path from discovery choice to first lesson, completion, repeat learning, and paid conversion.
findings.suggested_action: Define a privacy-safe page-level funnel with stable discovery-path labels and measure entry, first-lesson start, completion, seven-day repeat learning, and attributable paid conversion without free-form user data.

findings.summary: The entry surface exposes many simultaneous discovery modes without evidence that a first-time learner can identify the best next lesson quickly.
findings.suggested_action: Define one outcome-oriented first-step path for new learners, retain exploration for returning learners, and compare time-to-first-lesson and repeat learning against the current surface.

findings.summary: An 8,483-line stateful page coordinates discovery, content loading, progress, sharing, quizzes, RLHF, and analytics, raising the cost of safely improving the learner funnel.

findings.summary: The configured /admin/analytics review URL does not match the application route /admin, so automated and human checks cannot prove that they reached the intended dashboard.
findings.suggested_action: Choose one canonical URL, add an explicit compatibility alias or redirect for the other path, and protect both with a route-level contract test before changing shared links.

findings.summary: Several independent metric loaders turn failures into empty, hidden, null, or debug-only states without a page-level freshness and completeness ledger.

findings.summary: A 6,362-line page combines many operator domains, but available tests and telemetry do not show which panels shorten decisions or improve commercial outcomes.
findings.suggested_action: Define the top three recurring operator decisions, group panels by decision and cadence, record time-to-decision and action completion, and continue extracting independently tested modules.
